definitions.explanation: The mature ovary of a flowering plant, typically containing seeds. A formal or technical term for fruit.
Figuratively, the results or rewards of one's efforts or work.

examples.japanese: この{木|き}は{毎年|まいとし}{果実|かじつ}を{実|みの}らせる。
examples.english: This tree bears fruit every year.

examples.japanese: {果実|かじつ}にはビタミンが{豊富|ほうふ}に{含|ふく}まれている。
{努力|どりょく}の{果実|かじつ}を{手|て}にした。
examples.english: I obtained the fruits of my labor.

notes:
REGISTER: More formal/technical than {果物|くだもの}.

USAGE DIFFERENCE:
・{果実|かじつ} - botanical/scientific term; includes tomatoes, cucumbers as 'fruits'; also used figuratively
・{果物|くだもの} - everyday word for edible sweet fruits

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{果実|かじつ}酒 (fruit wine/liqueur)
・{果実|かじつ}ジュース (fruit juice)
・{乾燥|かんそう}{果実|かじつ} (dried fruit)

FIGURATIVE USE:
・{努力|どりょく}の{果実|かじつ} (fruits of one's labor)
・{研究|けんきゅう}の{果実|かじつ} (fruits of research)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{果物|くだもの} (fruit - everyday word)
・{実|み} (fruit, nut - native Japanese word)
・フルーツ (fruit - loanword, often for fresh fruit)
